10 November 2026

Economic Bulletin Issue 4/2026

Additional information

Inflation is projected to average 2.4% in 2026.

Risks to growth were tilted to the downside.

The Governing Council stood ready to adjust all of its instruments within its mandate.

Technical appendix

Core inflation is projected to decline gradually towards 2.3% in 2027.

Methodology

The estimates are based on seasonally adjusted data.

European Central Bank, 2026
